description: This file implements a Win32 window class for a Flutter Windows application, managing window creation, theming (dark/light mode), DPI support, and window class registration.

classes.name: WindowClassRegistrar
classes.description: Singleton class managing registration and unregistration of the window class.

classes.name: Win32Window
classes.description: Class representing a Win32 window with theming, DPI support, and message handling.

methods.name: Scale
methods.description: Helper function to scale logical units to physical pixels based on DPI.

methods.name: EnableFullDpiSupportIfAvailable
methods.description: Dynamically loads and enables DPI support if available.

methods.name: GetInstance
methods.description: Returns singleton instance of WindowClassRegistrar.

methods.name: GetWindowClass
methods.description: Returns the window class name, registering it if necessary.

methods.name: UnregisterWindowClass
methods.description: Unregisters the window class.

methods.name: Win32Window
methods.description: Constructor, increments active window count.

methods.name: ~Win32Window
methods.description: Destructor, decrements active window count and destroys window.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates the window with specified title, origin, and size.

methods.name: Show
methods.description: Shows the window.

methods.name: WndProc
methods.description: Static window procedure handling window messages.

methods.name: MessageHandler
methods.description: Handles specific window messages like destroy, DPI change, resize, activate, theming.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Destroys the window and unregisters class if needed.

methods.name: GetThisFromHandle
methods.description: Retrieves Win32Window instance from window handle.

methods.name: SetChildContent
methods.description: Sets a child window as content.

methods.name: GetClientArea
methods.description: Returns the client area rectangle.

methods.name: GetHandle
methods.description: Returns the window handle.

methods.name: SetQuitOnClose
methods.description: Sets whether to quit application on window close.

methods.name: OnCreate
methods.description: Hook for additional creation logic.

methods.name: OnDestroy
methods.description: Hook for additional destruction logic.

methods.name: UpdateTheme
methods.description: Updates window theme based on registry setting for dark/light mode.
